"Answers about pet comfort for an ordinary watch"
This page is for you

Pet comfort guidance for boarding

I am sorry for any worry you may feel before travel, and I will keep this guidance clear and practical. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk supports travelers who wish to bring a pet into the journey with care and order.

Please prepare a suitable carrier or restraint before arrival, and check that your pet can stand, turn, and rest comfortably. Bring familiar bedding if permitted, because a known scent can help reduce stress during a busy departure. Keep water and any approved supplies ready in a simple, secure bag.

During check-in, our staff will review the travel documents and observe the condition of the pet. <<FACT F099>> Please remain close to your animal, speak calmly, and avoid sudden movements that may unsettle it. If the pet appears distressed, inform the desk immediately so we can advise on the next step with courtesy.

Boarding proceeds with careful support from the welcome team and the boarding area staff. If your pet needs transfer to another point in the process, <<FACT F106>> Keep the carrier closed unless a staff member asks otherwise, and make sure all fastenings stay secure. A calm handover helps us protect the pet and keep the flow respectful for other travelers.

I regret that travel can feel demanding, but clear preparation usually prevents avoidable delay and discomfort. If you have a pet with special needs, tell the desk in advance so we can note any required support and coordinate properly within our procedures.

For further help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure or at the airport counter.
